subject: expr: Support `unix_timestamp` pushdown to TiKV (#59498)
summary: Diff only touches `pkg/expression`: it enables TiKV pushdown for `unix_timestamp(expr)` by whitelisting `ast.UnixTimestamp` in `scalarExprSupportedByTiKV`, while explicitly rejecting the stmt-timestamp-dependent `tipb.ScalarFuncSig_UnixTimestampCurrent` (0-arg) signature; unit tests cover the pushdown and the forbidden current signature. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the change, and no later upstream/master history indicates a follow-up fix for this logic.
